# IMPERIA CW — Cold War: shared Colonial Affairs.
# Generated by tools/colonial_affairs/compile.py.

on_actions = {
	on_startup = {
		effect = {
			every_country = {
				limit = { IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes }
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_bootstrapped }
					}
					COLDWAR_COL_daily = yes
					COLDWAR_COL_select_next = yes
					set_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_bootstrapped
				}
				else = {
					COLDWAR_COL_recalculate_budget = yes
					COLDWAR_COL_refresh_view = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	on_daily = {
		effect = {
			COLDWAR_COL_daily = yes
		}
	}
}
